Class Venue

java.lang.Object
york.studentevents.venues.Venue
All Implemented Interfaces:
IEntity, IVenue
public class Venue extends Object implements IVenue
Represents a venue at which events can be held, identified by name, address, and capacity.

    • Venue

      public Venue(String name, String address, int capacity)
      Creates a Venue with a maximum attendee capacity.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the venue.
      address - the address of the venue.
      capacity - the maximum number of attendees the venue can hold.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any of the parameters are null, blank, or empty, or if capacity is less than one.
